profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman Space Systems

positions.title: Aerodynamics/Mechanical Engineering Lab Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Led a mechanical/aerospace lab section specifically for analyzing different forms of head protection using a testing apparatus with a dummy head and various sensors. Guided undergraduate students with using the testing apparatus, using LabView software, and developing a formal experimental design document. 
- Graded homework assignments and lab reports.

positions.title: Co President of Hoos Flying/UVA Aero Design Team
positions.description:
- Helped lead team to 3rd place overall in 2019 and 5th place overall in 2018 at the International SAE Aero Design East Competition
- Organized overall logistics of team, such as competition travel and transportation, team meetings, and flight tests 
- Managed competition budget, funding requests from various organizations (UVA Student Council, UVA Parents Fund, UVA Experiential Learning Fund, UVA Engineering Student Council), and membership dues 
- Acted as a key lead in the propulsion team by developing test matrices for static and dynamic thrust tests and carrying them out to determine the optimal propulsion system 
- Acted as corporate liaison for a sponsorship from Leidos
- Used EagleTree telemetry system to analyze competition plane performance (eg stall speed) 
- Conducted preliminary FEA analysis on landing gear using SolidWorks to determine potential areas of failure 
- Assisted in building competition plane assembly with SolidWorks 
- Used laser cutters to fabricate various SolidWorks parts 
- Constructed high-quality competition plane with the team

positions.title: Product Definition Intern
positions.description:
- Evaluated and mapped out variances between limits in service and manufacturing for 1st stage turbine vane in formal technical presentation and report 
- Created formal software specification document for a tool streamlining an audit process and its prototype using Excel VBA 
- Optimized CADIQ reports data analysis process by automating specific steps using Excel VBA (allowed user to compile data from multiple files in less than 5 minutes, compared to manual process that took ~ 6.75 hours) 
- Updated a fluid systems database by adding missing fluid fittings and their associated specifications to allow engineers to have an up-to-date resource for their design

positions.title: Cyber Solutions Network Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote Java scripts to create additional functionality into Jira using Jira APIs to automate certain processes, such as ensuring internal BAH employees and outside contractors belonged to correct user-groups 
- Assisted ~2,000/~500 software development projects with migration, customization, integration, and overall project/user support within Atlassian suite of tools
- Gathered data, conducted testing, defined security and utility of existing project management and process automation tools undergoing a renewal process
- Conducted an Analysis of Alternatives as a part of the team's new product evaluation 
- Provided Jira system performance support by creating a workflow and issue type audits and consolidating these items
 - Participated in team booth organization, preparation, data gathering, demoing, and providing 1-on-1 personal user FAQ sessions 
- Intern for Summer 2017 and Winter 2017-18

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Provided positive customer service experience and effectively communicated with team members and managers to maintain and organize store products and maximize daily sales.
